script.text: Yusei rushed to meet Roman, the leader of the Dark Signers and Rex Goodwin's brother.
Yusei thought this would be their final showdown.
I'm glad you made it. I thought you would be too torn up over what you did to your friend.
What I did? Kalin chose his own path. I am not responsible for him.
If anyone’s to blame, it’s YOU, Roman! You took advantage of a messed-up kid!
There's no need to get worked up. I wasn’t blaming you. We all did exactly what destiny wanted us to do.
You were meant to destroy your friend. Just as I was meant to destroy your father!
My father?
How fascinating that the Signer hoping to defeat me is Professor Fudo’s son.
You’re up against a force you can’t begin to comprehend. A force awoken by your father.
Twenty years ago, your father discovered planetary particles.
These particles act like planetary gears, binding otherwise unrelated particles to one another.
Your father’s team began conducting experiments using planetary particles to build and manipulate greater molecular structures.
This led to the discovery of Ener-D and the creation of the Ener-D Reactor.
That's when Rex and I joined his team as research assistants. Everyone was excited about the possibilities the Reactor was presenting.
The research was proceeding smoothly... until that fateful day.
Every time we conducted a test with the Ener-D Reactor, unusual weather events descended on New Domino City.
Worried, the Professor wanted to put a stop to the experiments and shut the reactor down.
I wasn’t happy to say the least, so I did some investigating. I discovered that in the far-off Nazca Lines, similar weather conditions were happening at the same time as our tests.
So I decided to journey to the Nazca Lines to find out as much information as I could.
I learned of a local legend where every five thousand years, powerful spirits rise up and battle there.
The Nazca Lines were said to be evil spirits that were sealed away, defeated by the Great Dragon during their last battle.
I drove out to see these Lines for myself where I met a man. A man from Iliaster.
Iliaster?
He somehow knew of the Ener-D experiments and said they needed to continue.
That's when I heard...something unexplainable. It wasn’t a voice like me talking to you. It wasn’t...words.
The voice made me understand that the Ener-D Reactor had the power to break the seals of the Nazca Lines and release the Army of Shadows.
It was destiny's instrument, and the voice convinced me that I was the one to play it.
I ousted Professor Fudo and destroyed the Ener-D Reactor, leading to Zero Reverse–a cataclysm so devastating that it split New Domino City in two and opened the door to the Netherworld.
So the history books were wrong! It wasn't my father's fault that the city was destroyed!
No, Yusei. Your father was a self-righteous bore who couldn't see the magnificence of the Ener-D Reactor.
He was a failure–and you will be too! For I shall resurrect the King of the Netherworld!
